content.title: All Goals!: Bayern Munich vs Real Madrid – Champions League Live
content.text: Real Madrid are eliminated from the UEFA Champions League in a thrilling match that sends Bayern Munich through to the semifinals. BAY 6-4 RMA El gol de Olise que le da al Bayern el pase a semifinales. BAY 4-3 RMA (6-4). Min 93: It’s over! GOOOOOOOOOOOOAL for Bayern! Olise nails the final coffin for Real Madrid and scores the fourth for the Germans, who will be in the semifinals. Luis Díaz’s stunning goal. BAY 3-3 RMA (5-4). Min 88: GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAL! What a goal by Luis Díaz. A long-range strike into the corner that gives Lunin no chance. It levels the match, but leaves Bayern ahead on aggregate. Mbappé’s goal puts Real Madrid ahead on aggregate. BAY 2-3 RMA. (4-4) Min 41: Goooooooooooooooooal for Real Madrid! Kylian Mbappé puts the Spanish side ahead again. What a crazy match. Harry Kane’s equalizer and Upamecano’s brilliant pass. BAY 2-2 RMA. Min 37: Gooooooooooooooal for Bayern Munich! Harry Kane… the “Hurricane” levels the match and puts Bayern ahead in the tie. A top-class finish that leaves Lunin with no chance, after he had already made a couple of saves. Note: a spectacular pass from Upamecano, channeling Kimmich. Stunning goal by Arda Güler, his first brace in the Champions League. BAY 1-2 RMA. Min 30: What a gooooooooooooooooooal by Arda Güler! From a free kick, he puts it far beyond Neuer’s reach. A beautiful strike that clears the wall; the Turkish player grabs a brace and levels the aggregate again. BAY 1-2 RMA.Pavlović scores, Bayern equalize. BAY 1-1 RMA. Min 6: GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAL for Bayern Munich! Immediate German response. Corner kick by Kimmich and, on the line, Pavlović finishes; Lunin also contributes by not coming out. Double goalkeeper error, double goal. Bayern regain the lead. Here’s Güler’s goal and Manuel Neuer’s mistake. BAY 0-1 RMA Min 1: Gooooooooooooal for Real Madrid! Arda Güler takes advantage of a huge mistake by Manuel Neuer to level the aggregate score and add drama to the match.The “European Classic” returns to the spotlight, this time taking place at the Allianz Arena. Bayern Munich and Real Madrid face off in a tie full of history, with very even numbers and two teams arriving in very different contexts.Head-to-head record They have met on 29 occasions, with a slight advantage for the German side: 13 wins for Bayern Munich and 12 for Real Madrid.In terms of all-time scorers in this fixture, Giovane Élber leads for the Bavarian side with 4 goals, while Cristiano Ronaldo is the top scorer in the matchup with 9 goals for Real Madrid.Recent meetings in Germany The recent record clearly favors Real Madrid:2023/24: Bayern 2-2 Real Madrid 2017/18: Bayern 1-2 Real Madrid 2016/17: Bayern 1-2 Real Madrid 2013/14: Bayern 0-4 Real Madrid 2011/12: Bayern 2-1 Real Madrid Real Madrid have not lost in Munich since 2012 and have scored at least two goals in their last four visits to the Allianz Arena, a key factor heading into a potential comeback. Lineup Bayern Munich Lineup Real Madrid How Real Madrid arrives The Spanish giants are not going through their best moment. They arrive having gone three matches without a win: a 2-1 defeat to Mallorca, a 1-1 draw against Girona at the Bernabéu, and a 1-2 home loss in the first leg of this tie.This forces the team to score at least two goals to advance to the semifinals. Even so, there are reasons for optimism: in their recent matches in Germany, Real Madrid have shown strong attacking efficiency.They will be without Aurélien Tchouaméni due to suspension, but their full attacking arsenal will be available. Kylian Mbappé, Vinícius Jr., and Jude Bellingham will lead a side that needs a perfect night.How Bayern Munich arrives Bayern Munich are in excellent form. They come in on a 10-match unbeaten run in the Bundesliga, having already surpassed 100 goals and with the league title practically secured.In the DFB-Pokal they are in the semifinals, and in the Champions League they have only lost one match. At home, their performances are very solid: they average two goals per game at the Allianz Arena in European competition.They have only lost once at home all season, a 1-2 defeat to Augsburg on January 24, which remains their only loss of the campaign.Everything is set for another chapter in this historic rivalry. Real Madrid need an epic comeback, and Bayern Munich want to make their home strength count. History is once again on the line.
